    • setStartingPosition

      public void setStartingPosition(int x, int y, jmt.jmch.animation.Direction d, int finalPos)
      Method to set the staring point position of a job. It is called by an edge that have this new Job on its route.
      Parameters:
      x - x position of the Job
      y - y position of the Job
      d - direction of the movement
      finalPos - index of the array of edges of the next point

    • updatePosition

      public void updatePosition(double x, double y)
      Method to update the position of a moving job. It is different than the setStartingPoisition, since here we do not have to remove the circleSize/2 part
      Parameters:
      x - x position of the Job
      y - y position of the Job
